title: THE WAY TO 5TH KYU

techniques: Gedan uchi uke, jodan tateken zuki
Neko ashi dachi, hiki uke, mae ashi kin geri
Neko ashi dachi, hiki uke, zenkutsu dachi, gyaku zuki, neko ashi dachi, hiki uke
Basic block – sukui uke, kaishu gedan harai uke
Kakie – Gekisai Dai Ni hiki uke bunkai (Nodo tsukami)
Makiwara – mawashi hiji ate, ushiro hiji ate

knowledge.term: Dojo kun in Japanese and its meaning
knowledge.meaning: Know the five dojo kun: perfect character, seek the true way, cultivate perseverance, respect etiquette and refrain from uncontrolled behavior.
Know the ceremony commands: shugo, ki o tsuke, seiza, mokuso, mokuso yame, shomen ni rei, sensei ni rei, otagai ni rei and kiritsu.

history: Sensei Anichi Miyagi started training karate under Sensei Chojun Miyagi after World War II
Sensei Shuichi Aragaki - Direct student of Sensei Chojun Miyagi, trained with Sensei Anichi Miyagi, IOGKF technical advisor
Three major Okinawan karate styles were Naha-Te, Shuri-Te, Tomari-Te
